biotools.summary: Toolkit for FAIR-bioHeaders (FHR) metadata on genomic data files. It embeds validated provenance metadata headers with a checksum in FASTA, GFA and GFF3 files (combine), strips and verifies them, validates metadata against the FHR, FHP and FHGFF3 schemas, converts metadata between JSON, YAML, JSON-LD and HTML microdata, and assesses FAIRness. It ships as a Python library and command-line tool (bioheaders), with Galaxy tool wrappers, nf-core-style Nextflow modules and a Nextflow workflow.
